ambiguities.description: The deal says '85% of net' but does not specify whether 'net' means gross minus the capped expenses ($650 ceiling) or gross minus actual expenses (which could exceed the cap). If actuals run over the cap, the two readings produce different payouts.

plausibleReadings.summary: Net is calculated after the cap-limited expenses, so the venue absorbs any overage above $650.
plausibleReadings.impact: Artist-favorable when actual expenses exceed $650. On a show where actuals hit $900, artist sees ~$212 more (85% of the $250 difference).

plausibleReadings.summary: Net is calculated after actual expenses, with $650 stated as a soft target rather than a hard ceiling.
plausibleReadings.impact: Venue-favorable when actuals exceed $650. Same $900 actuals scenario costs the artist ~$212 versus reading p1.

ambiguities.suggestedClarification: Is the $650 expense figure a hard cap (venue eats any overage) or an estimate, with net calculated on actual expenses? This affects the 85% base.

sourceText: 1,291 g'tee vs 85% of net. Expenses to 650. Hospitality $600.
